technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Boot for application setup and configuration management.
Integrate RxJava module using Spring's reactive programming support for flexibility.
Design ACL system as a plugin with a DSL for configuration, considering user-defined access controls.
Employ profiling tools like JProfiler to analyze CPU startup bottlenecks.
Utilize Hadoop client libraries for HDFS integration to ensure high availability.
Implement configuration overrides via Spring properties for HDFS and YARN settings.
Leverage SparkContext or YARN API for stopping Spark jobs and managing cleanup.
assumptions: Development environment is configured with Java 17+, Maven/Gradle, and necessary Spring dependencies.
All required libraries and tools (e.g., RxJava, Hadoop, Spark) are available and accessible.
No external dependencies or team collaborations are needed, as all work is performed personally.
Estimates are based on a single developer's capacity and assume no significant interruptions.
Testing is conducted in a controlled environment with access to HDFS and YARN clusters.

activities.activity_description: Develop a flexible RxJava module for use as a processor in Spring applications, including coding, unit tests, and integration tests.
Conduct a spike to review customer use cases, design ACL system specifications, identify DSL and UI scope, and document next steps and phases.
Investigate high CPU startup time by profiling, identify bottlenecks, document reasons, and list pros/cons for admin and container servers.
Implement option to store custom module uber-jar in HDFS for high availability, including reliable read/reinstall under failure scenarios and testing.
Implement ability to override HDFS location for custom module uber-jar storage and retrieval, with configuration and testing.
Implement ability to override YARN config location for custom module uber-jar storage and retrieval, including configuration and validation.
Implement functionality to stop existing Spark job for resource cleanup upon completion, with integration and error handling tests.
Perform comprehensive integration testing across all developed modules to ensure compatibility and functionality within the Spring ecosystem.
Complete project documentation, including code comments, user guides, and final reports for delivery and review.
